answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the prism check immediately, the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set and the saffron replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 39 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 39 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
